description: Source file for MPU utility functions and hardware exception handling for STM32F4 microcontroller, including stack management, fault handling, SPI configuration, BOR (Brown-Out Reset) management, and CAN bus detection.

methods.name: getRemainingStack
methods.description: Calculates remaining stack space depending on context and compiler.

methods.name: baseHardwareInit
methods.description: Initializes hardware, resets cycle counter, and sets BOR level.

methods.name: prvGetRegistersFromStack
methods.description: Collects register values for postmortem debugging from stack.

methods.name: HardFaultVector
methods.description: Handles hard fault exceptions, inspects fault status, and may break into debugger.

methods.name: isValidCan1RxPin
methods.description: Checks if a pin is valid for CAN1 RX.

methods.name: isValidCan1TxPin
methods.description: Checks if a pin is valid for CAN1 TX.

methods.name: isValidCan2RxPin
methods.description: Checks if a pin is valid for CAN2 RX.

methods.name: isValidCan2TxPin
methods.description: Checks if a pin is valid for CAN2 TX.

methods.name: detectCanDevice
methods.description: Detects and returns the CAN driver based on RX and TX pins.
